title: 第1869章 熟能生巧第1868章 矿脉速成
slug: 培养神兽很难我有十只
content_zh:
好在这次跟之前不同，只是灵力消耗的多了点，等补充回来后就好了。
慕蔷薇还是有点不放心他，勒令他三天后才能再次出门。
既然他能让矿母快速变成灵矿脉，那便不急于一时，十天半个月还是等得起的，他的身体最重要。
慕蔷薇道：“别以为你和雪宝能偷偷溜出去。”
她知道楚少野是个闲不住的，一能动就想往外跑，以她的实力现在也无法察觉他的一举一动，就给他的院子里多安排了十几个侍女时刻盯着他。
楚少野：……不至于这么做吧？
慕蔷薇安排好后就离开了，那颗荒星上的灵矿脉已经形成，虽然现在只是小型矿脉，但已经可以开采了，她还有很多事要安排。
负责看守矿脉的人要增多，还有负责开采和提炼灵矿的工人。
紫衡星原本并不以灵矿资源为主，懂灵矿的人不是很多，但好在白沙星来的炼器师还在，可以请他们先帮帮忙，等带出一批人来后就好了。
楚少野被勒令留在星主府中修养，其实他本来就没想在恢复之前就出门，现在被这么多双眼睛盯着更是只能老实，不然等慕蔷薇知道绝对会生气。
金线寻宝鼠从颊囊空间中掏出不少灵果，它吃一颗给灵主喂一颗。
它跟捣药玉兔那只抠门的兔子可不一样，灵果就是用来吃的，不知道它攒那么多干什么。
当然它也就是给楚少野吃，别人想吃它的东西绝没有这么简单。
安心在星主府中修养了三天，楚少野的灵力早就补充回来了，身体中由内而外的那种空虚感也消散不少，回到了原来的状态。
他去了另外一颗荒星，想把这颗荒星上的矿母也加速形成矿脉，这次慕蔷薇和他一起。
三天时间，荒星变成资源星的消息已经在紫衡星上传开，星球上的人都很是震惊，不是说最少也要七八年的时间吗，怎么灵矿脉这就形成了？
等他们听说楚少野还有一只时间属性灵宠，是他让灵矿脉缩短时间快速形成，惊讶至于竟然还有种理所当然的感觉。
他们少主那么厉害，能拥有时间属性灵宠好像也不是多么令人惊讶的事。
这对他们无疑来说是个好消息，有家底的那些人自然不用担心十年后新紫衡星才有足够的资源，他们却不同，手里仅有的一点资源根本不够他们支撑那么久。
现在好了，他们可以到资源星上开采灵矿了。

只是这一颗资源星肯定不够，尤其现在这颗资源星上只有一条小型灵矿脉，所有楚少野才想让沧粟蜉蝣皇尽快把所有荒星都加速形成资源星。
金色传送法阵张开，楚少野和慕蔷薇的身影出现在一颗荒星上，星球上的看守看到两人很是激动，他们已经知道星主和少主来是要做什么，但还是激动。
在荒星上看守矿母的活是清闲，但也很是无聊，想回一趟宜居星也麻烦。
等灵矿脉形成后就不一样了，星球很快就能发展起来，来这里的人只会越来越多，对他们来说也是好事。
有上次的经验，这次楚少野轻车熟路很多，他召唤出沧粟蜉蝣皇，柔和的金色光波扩散开，很快地底下就传出熟悉的震动。
content_en:
Fortunately, this time is different from before. It just consumes a little more spiritual power. It will be fine when it is replenished.
Mu Qiangwei was still a little worried about him and ordered him to go out again in three days.
Since he can quickly turn the ore mother into a spiritual mineral vein, there is no rush. Ten days and a half months can still be waited for. His body is the most important thing.
Mu Qiangwei said: "Don't think you and Xuebao can sneak out."
She knew that Chu Shaoye was restless and wanted to run out as soon as he could move. With her strength, she could not detect his every move, so she arranged a dozen more maids in his yard to keep an eye on him.
Chu Shaoye: ...You won’t do this, right?
Mu Qiangwei left after making arrangements. The spiritual mineral vein on the deserted star had been formed. Although it was only a small vein now, it was ready for mining. She still had many things to arrange.
There will be more people responsible for guarding the mineral veins, as well as workers responsible for mining and refining the spiritual minerals.
Ziheng Star did not originally focus on spiritual mineral resources, and there were not many people who knew about spiritual minerals. Fortunately, the weapon refiners from Baisha Star are still there. You can ask them to help first, and it will be fine after a group of people are brought out.
Chu Shaoye was ordered to stay in the Star Lord's mansion to recuperate. In fact, he had no intention of going out before recovering. Now that he was being stared at by so many pairs of eyes, he had no choice but to be honest, otherwise Mu Qiangwei would definitely be angry when she found out.
The golden-threaded treasure-hunting mouse took out a lot of spiritual fruits from the space in its cheek pouch. It ate one and fed one to the spiritual master.
It is different from the stingy rabbit that is the Jade Rabbit. Spirit fruits are only for eating. I don’t know why it saves so many.
Of course, it is only for Chu Shaoye to eat. It is not that simple for others to eat it.
An Xin had been cultivating in the Star Lord's Mansion for three days. Chu Shaoye's spiritual power had long been replenished, and the emptiness in his body from the inside out had also dissipated a lot, returning to its original state.
He went to another desolate star, hoping to speed up the formation of mineral veins on this desolate star. Mu Qiangwei was with him this time.
Within three days, the news that the Desolate Star had turned into a Resource Star had spread on the Ziheng Star. Everyone on the planet was shocked. Didn't it take at least seven or eight years? How could the Spiritual Mineral Veins be formed like this?
When they heard that Chu Shaoye also had a time-attributed spiritual pet, and that he was the one who caused the spiritual mineral veins to shorten the time and form quickly, they were surprised that they still felt it was natural.
Their young master is so powerful, it doesn't seem that surprising that he can have a time-attributed spiritual pet.
This is undoubtedly good news for them. Those with wealth naturally don't have to worry about New Ziheng Star having enough resources ten years later. But they are different. The few resources they have are not enough to sustain them for that long.
Now, they can go to the resource star to mine spiritual minerals.
But this one resource star is definitely not enough, especially now that there is only a small spiritual mineral vein on this resource star, so Chu Shaoye wants Cangsu Mayfly Emperor to speed up all the waste stars to form resource stars as soon as possible.
The golden teleportation circle opened, and the figures of Chu Shaoye and Mu Qiangwei appeared on a deserted star. The guards on the planet were very excited when they saw the two. They already knew what the star master and the young master were coming to do, but they were still excited.
The job of guarding the mine mother on the deserted star is relaxing, but it is also very boring. It is also troublesome to go back to the habitable star.
It will be different after the spiritual mineral veins are formed. The planet will develop quickly, and more and more people will come here, which is also a good thing for them.
With the experience last time, Chu Shaoye was more familiar with the road this time. He summoned the Mayfly Emperor, and the soft golden light waves spread out, and soon there was a familiar vibration from the ground.
